glossary.definition: A measurement of how the service behaves for its users: a ratio of good events to all events, or a threshold on a latency distribution.
The target an indicator must meet over a window, for example 99.9% of requests under 500 ms over 30 days.
An operational alert the engine evaluates: something is wrong now, not a budget burning.
A system that stores and serves one kind of signal — metrics, logs or traces — for the dashboards and alerts to read.
The share of the window an objective allows to fail: 1 − target. A burn-rate alert fires when it is spent too fast.
How much harm an outage would do, from tier 1 (the most critical) to tier 3; the tier decides which conformance clauses apply.
